nodes.title: What the domains share
nodes.text: The terms the domains share and the rules that bind more than one of them.

children.title: regular
children.text: A patron the saloon runs a tab for, known by name.

children.title: tab
children.text: The account the saloon keeps for a regular: its journal, the charges and repayments written to it, and its limit, the most the regular may owe on it.

children.title: charge
children.text: An amount a regular comes to owe on their tab, for an order or a booking.

children.title: repayment
children.text: An amount a regular pays back on their tab.

children.title: debt
children.text: What a regular owes on their tab: the sum of the charges on its journal less the sum of the repayments on it.

tests: test/tabs.test.ts::@spec s-r64zmxy6x6bvzyw reads a regular's debt off the journal: its charges less its repayments

children.title: supply
children.text: A thing the saloon keeps in stock and sells at the bar by the piece, such as a bottle or a plate of beans.

children.title: order
children.text: What a regular asks for at the bar at one time: one or more supplies, each with how many of it.

children.title: room
children.text: A bedroom upstairs that the saloon lets.

children.title: booking
children.text: The letting of a room to a regular for 24 hours, from the instant the booking is made.

decisions.problem: A booking let a room for one night, whereas the saloon lets a room for 24 hours from the instant the booking is made, and those hours may fall across two nights.
decisions.ruling: The owner: a room is let for 24 hours from the instant its booking is made; the nights those hours hold are not counted, no room is let by the hour, and none is booked ahead.

children.title: A refusal changes nothing
children.text: A domain that refuses an operation, or any part of it, leaves everything the domains keep as it was.
children.reason: A refusal that changed anything would carry out a part of what it refused.

tests: test/rooms.test.ts::@spec s-j3b7zs9299nj5fr leaves the rooms and the tab as they were when a booking is refused
test/stock.test.ts::@spec s-j3b7zs9299nj5fr leaves the stock as it was when taking is refused

children.title: A request names only what the saloon keeps
children.text: Each domain refuses a request that names something of a kind the domain keeps — a tab, a supply, a room — that it does not hold, except the tab a request opens.
children.reason: A request naming what the saloon does not keep has nothing to act on: no tab to charge, repay or read, no supply to take or price, no room to let.

tests: test/rooms.test.ts::@spec s-xgkgb3kvcbs7x5v refuses a room the rooms do not let, and a regular the tabs keep no tab for
test/stock.test.ts::@spec s-xgkgb3kvcbs7x5v refuses a supply the stock does not hold, whether read, priced or taken
test/tabs.test.ts::@spec s-xgkgb3kvcbs7x5v refuses what names a regular the tabs keep no tab for, except the tab a request opens

children.title: An order goes on the tab whole or not at all
children.text: The tabs take a regular's order as one operation: they take out of the stock as many of each supply as the order asks for and write the order's price to the regular's journal as a charge.
children.reason: An order carried out in part leaves the stock and the tab disagreeing about what the regular had: supplies gone that nobody owes for, or a debt for supplies still on the shelf.

tests: test/tabs.test.ts::@spec s-ghhractkb4sywee puts an order on the tab whole, taking its supplies out of the stock and charging its price, or not at all

children.title: A booking goes on the tab whole or not at all
children.text: The rooms book a room for a regular as one operation: they let the room and have the room's price written to the regular's tab as a charge.
children.reason: A booking and its charge carried out apart leave the rooms and the tab disagreeing about what the regular had: a room let that nobody owes for, or a debt for a room never let.

tests: test/rooms.test.ts::@spec s-5f774mswy72x3gh lets the room and writes the room's price to the regular's tab as a charge, as one operation
